name: Reliv Kiosk
description: Reliv Kiosk is a self-service health screening kiosk, also called a Health ATM, from Reliv Medicare Private Limited in Kolkata, India. It supports everyday health, fitness and wellness awareness in campuses, workplaces, gyms and community spaces.
calculatedMetrics: BMI, calculated from height and weight
configurationNote: Available sensors, optional eyesight screening, body-composition estimates and report access depend on the installed configuration. Confirm the included features with Reliv before purchase or visiting a kiosk.
sessionTime: A typical screening session takes about 3 minutes; timing depends on the selected checks and setup.

pricing.purchase: Listed machine purchase cost: ₹95,000 one-time. Confirm taxes, configuration, installation and support in a written quote.
pricing.lease: Listed flat rental: ₹12,000/month. Confirm eligibility, term, maintenance and inclusions.
pricing.checkup: Checkup and digital-report charges depend on the station and service selected. Check the displayed price before payment.
pricing.note: Machine cost and monthly rental reflect repository pricing updates merged on 13 November 2026. These are different billing models; confirm tax and deployment inclusions.

visitNote: These are listed partner-venue stations. Confirm current availability, access and opening hours before travelling.
recognition: DPIIT startup recognition DIPP287544; see the certificate on the website. Startup recognition is not medical-device approval.
disclaimer: Reliv provides screening information for awareness. It does not provide a medical diagnosis or replace professional medical advice.
sourceNote: Facts reconciled from the existing public site and repository on 2026-11-11; operational, pricing and clinical claims require confirmation by the business owner.
